subject.title: refactor(agents): make API registry ownership lifecycle-local

question: Should OpenClaw adopt per-`ModelRegistry` API registry ownership as the permanent runtime boundary while retaining a snapshot-based process-default Plugin SDK compatibility facade?
rationale: This XL refactor changes central provider-routing ownership and compatibility behavior rather than merely repairing an isolated call site; only maintainers can confirm the desired long-term SDK and lifecycle contract.

options.title: Confirm lifecycle-local ownership
options.body: Accept the per-registry runtime architecture after adding inspectable proof that independent refreshes cannot cross-route providers and that the default SDK facade remains compatible.

options.title: Preserve a shared runtime contract
options.body: Pause and redesign the change if the process-default registry is intended to remain authoritative for any supported agent or Plugin SDK runtime path.

recommendation.title: Confirm lifecycle-local ownership
recommendation.body: Accept the per-registry runtime architecture after adding inspectable proof that independent refreshes cannot cross-route providers and that the default SDK facade remains compatible.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit series and PR rationale identify steipete as the contributor most directly connected to the proposed lifecycle boundary.
